Editor-only MIT dependency from https://github.com/Whinarn/UnityMeshSimplifier pinned at 53fdb3122645bcd3ad2c258235200dff3dfbaa9b. Local opt-in patch: SimplificationOptions.ConstrainToEdgeSegment and constrained one-dimensional quadric minimization in MeshSimplifier.CalculateError. Default remains false; Fpp enables it for scan reduction. This keeps new vertices on their collapsed source edge segment instead of accepting unconstrained out-of-bounds minima. All other sources unmodified. Generated meshes are baked; this code is not included in the Android player. LICENSE.md retained.
